metadata.title: That 2 kill spree where I aimed at the floor and Valorant said ‘Sure, take it’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, I was just throwing shots at the floor!
Enemy gifted me kills like it’s a giveaway.
Click if your chaos plays always surprise you.
Valorant logic is straight trolling again.

Tap if your aim’s on vacation but kills still drop!
